name: ANSI/IEEE Foot-operated switch form
summary: IEEE-library form of foot-operated switch: a foot-operated switch uses a pedal mechanism to change an electrical contact.
description: This reference locates foot-operated switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous switches family. A foot-operated switch uses a pedal mechanism to change an electrical contact. Its schematic should state the contact state and whether the operator is momentary or retained. The public library uses HFT11 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Identify the pedal's return action and any guard shown by the equipment specification. Foot actuation describes the operator, not the safety category of the circuit. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
